artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: pen monotype on wove brown paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's head and shoulders facing forward. The face and hair are depicted with heavy, dark lines, giving a shadowed appearance. The person wears loosely fitted clothing. The background features a simple landscape with buildings, possibly a spire, and mountains in the distance. The sketch is monochromatic with dark shading on neutral paper.

artworks.title: Two Figures near a Hut
artworks.description: The image displays a composition of vertical and diagonal lines, curved shapes, and angular forms. Light and shadow create a dynamic setting. The shapes suggest trees, a forest, and abstract figures. The scene conveys a dense woodland with tree-like forms and possible human-like silhouettes.

artworks.title: Old Horse (Le vieux cheval)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse's head and neck. The drawing features the profile of a horse, capturing the details of its face, ears, and the texture of its neck and mane. The use of shading and lines suggests the animal's musculature and the flow of its mane. The background is plain, and the illustration is signed with an artist’s monogram within a circle near the base.

artworks.title: Man of Heights
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up in a landscape setting. The person faces left with a slightly angled body. They have short hair styled upwards and slightly backward, a prominent chin and nose, and wear an intricately textured suit with a visible shirt collar and tie. Their hand rests over their leg, above a hat placed on a railing or similar surface. The background includes hills, trees, buildings, a small church, and mountains in the distance.

artworks.title: Walk in the Shadow
artworks.description: The image features a sketch showing the side profile of a human figure in motion. The entire body of the person is visible, depicted with abstract and sketchy details. The person's posture is forward-leaning, with arms outstretched in front of them. The facial features are minimally detailed with simplified lines, and the hair is short with curved lines. The clothing is abstractly represented with flowy lines, suggesting a loose garment. The background has horizontal and vertical hatches suggesting motion, and the space around the figure is filled with dynamic lines. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The sketch is in a monochrome palette, and in the bottom right, there is a signature attributed to Barlach.

artworks.title: The Couple in the Crowd
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded indoor setting with people gathered around. The image features a dense grouping of figures in various states of interaction, possibly in a social or informal meeting. The scene is depicted in black and white with charcoal or pencil techniques, giving it a textured and sketch-like quality. In the center, a person is seated with several individuals surrounding them. The figures have exaggerated and expressive features, conveying movement and liveliness. The atmosphere appears enclosed, suggesting it is indoors, possibly in a dimly lit room or hall.

artworks.title: Karl Legien
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait drawing of a man from the chest up, in a seated position, facing slightly to the right. He has a prominent mustache and wavy hair styled back. He is dressed in a suit with a jacket, vest, shirt, and tie. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Woman and Child in Garden
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 19.7 x 25.6 cm (7 3/4 x 10 1/16 in.)
overall: 71.1 cm (28 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a garden scene with a pair of potted plants on a low wall or ledge. In the background, there are trees and two small figures, one likely an adult and the other a child. The artwork features dynamic brushstrokes and an etching technique, creating movement and texture in the foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with black and white tones defining shapes and shadows.

artworks.title: Olympia
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting down with their back and legs visible. They are supporting themselves with one arm and have short, dark hair. The person is nude, and the background suggests a natural, possibly coastal setting with water and landforms.

artworks.title: Five Girls at a Forest Pond (Funf Madchen am Waldteich)
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the composition, with rugged mountains in the distance creating sharp geometric forms against the sky. The mountains create a jagged boundary, above which clouds or sky are visible through dynamic brushstrokes. The brushstrokes are energetic and expressive, with a raw, textured quality. The color palette is stark, black and white, enhancing dramatic contrasts. Closest to us, a group of figures is depicted in an active stance, beside a body of water indicated by wavy lines. Stylized trees frame the scene, leading the eye towards the figures.

artworks.title: Courtyard with Tree and Houses (Ummauerter Hof mit Baum und Dachern)
artworks.description: The image shows an overhead view of a house and yard. There are buildings with rooftops in the upper portion, depicted with bold brushstrokes. The artwork is monochrome, using black and off-white colors. In the foreground, there is a stone wall leading to a yard with a tree, and a house is seen in the background.

artworks.title: Three Girls in front of a Mirror (Drei Madchen vor dem Speigel)
artworks.description: The image shows three nude figures seated in a diagonal line. The figure on the left is viewed in profile with an arm raised behind their head. The second figure is leaning forward, and the third figure, seated to the right, is turned towards the viewer with long hair framing her angular facial features. The background is textured and dark with light shading suggesting the floor. The style of the hair is depicted with simple, linear strokes, and the figures are rendered in an expressive and rough artistic style, emphasizing their contours and form against the contrasting background.

artworks.title: Finding of Moses (Auffindung des Moses)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black and yellow on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of four figures and a child in a natural setting surrounded by tall grass. The figures are depicted in various seated postures with their limbs accentuated by rough outlines and shaded areas. The color palette emphasizes tones of yellow and black, creating a stark contrast and texture throughout the scene. The style is reminiscent of Otto Müller, characterized by a flat, graphic quality that gives the figures a primitive yet expressive appearance. The simplistic line work and natural surroundings emphasize a theme of human connection with nature.

artworks.title: Irene Altman
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in a three-quarter view, focusing on the left side and upper body. The person is in a turned position, looking over their shoulder. The facial features include prominent eyebrows, defined eyes, and full lips. The hair is dark, straight, with bangs. Little detail is given for clothing. The background is textured and shaded, emphasizing the contours of the face. "Otto Mueller" is signed at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Mother and Child (Mutter und Kind)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals with their upper bodies and faces in focus. The person in the foreground faces forward with closed eyes, a slightly tilted head, and a slightly open mouth. They seem to be resting on the shoulder or arm of the person behind. The second person has their head leaning forward, eyes closed, and appears serene. Both individuals have dark, stylized hair. The person in front has tousled hair, while the person in the back has straight hair with bangs. They appear unclothed. The background is textured and patterned, creating an abstract setting. Signature marks are visible at the bottom right and left corners of the image.

artworks.title: Nude Figure
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract depiction of a person in a reclined position, with most of their body shown. The individual has angular facial features and short, straight dark hair with bangs. They are illustrated in yellow with black outlines, appearing nude. The background consists of abstract shapes and lines in shades of black and blue.

artworks.title: Nude Figure
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a kneeling female figure with her legs folded underneath her. Her arms are raised, hands behind her head. Facial features are minimal, with short hair and a dark triangle suggesting underwear. The background consists of broad strokes of orange, blue, and green, creating a half-framed effect. The setting is abstract with soft colors and lighter shades.

artworks.title: Girl on a Couch (Madchen auf dem Kanapee)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a reclining pose. The person is lying on their back with one arm behind their head and the other laying across their body. The facial features are depicted with high contrast and bold lines, focusing on pronounced eyebrows and elongated eyes, with a closed mouth. The person has short, dark hair styled close to the head. The clothing appears minimal and possibly involves a patterned fabric draped over the lower body. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is abstract and dark, contrasting with the lighter shades of the person's skin.

artworks.title: Landscape with Tree and Water (Landschaft mitBaum und Wasser)
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with dark linear brushstrokes suggesting abstract forms or foliage. The style consists of bold black strokes with finer textured lines for depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black on a light beige background. Abstract plant-like shapes are visible in the foreground, while sweeping lines in the background create a sense of flow.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Facing Left (Selbstbildnis nachlinks)
artworks.description: This image shows a close-up portrait of a person facing slightly to the left. The facial features are angular with prominent cheekbones and the person's expression appears focused. The person has dark, closely cropped hair and is wearing a collared garment. The portrait is rendered in a monochrome style with heavy, expressive lines and shading. The background is abstract with dynamic, crosshatched lines.

artworks.title: Standing Nude in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a natural setting. The person is facing slightly to the side with one arm extended to touch a tree. The person's face is in a three-quarters view with short, dark hair. The person is not wearing clothing. The surrounding landscape includes trees, leaves, and grass in a bold, impressionistic style with shades of blue, green, and grey. The background features expressive lines and colors.

artworks.title: Standing Boy and Two Girls (second version)  (Stehender Knabe und zwei Mädchen 2 )
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in a stylized, early 20th-century expressionist artwork. The central figure is standing, facing slightly right touching a tree branch. To the right, another figure stands facing away. On the left, a seated figure leans back with one arm resting on a bent knee. The figures have simplified facial features, with short, indistinct hairstyles. They are unclothed, set in a natural scene with foliage and distant hills or mountains in the background. The drawing is monochromatic with bold, dark lines on a light background.

artworks.title: Three Girls in Profile (Drei Madchen im Profile)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts the upper portions of three figures, positioned in profile facing left. They are closely aligned, with overlapping faces. The facial features are rendered with monochrome lines and shading, giving them a stylized appearance. The expressions are neutral, and the hair is depicted with textured strokes. The individuals are not shown wearing clothing. The background is shaded with crosshatched patterns, emphasizing the figure silhouettes. The drawing is done in a sketch-like style with thick lines and shading.

artworks.title: Standing, Sitting, and Bathing Girls near a Tree (Stehende, sitzendes und badendes Madchen am Baum)
artworks.description: The image shows bold, jagged lines depicting three human figures in an abstract landscape. The figures are simplified and stylized, set near a tree with outstretched branches and sharp, leaf-like shapes surrounding them. The scene appears to represent a natural setting with trees and foliage, created in an abstract style emphasizing form and contrast.
